question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.**

The Bank of New York has increased (**interest rates four times from last January**.)

options.text: interest rates four times since last January.
the interest rates four time from last January.
interest rates from last January, four times.

solution:
The correct answer is **"interest rates four times since last January."**
